themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Covers research and applications focused on AI agents capable of performing tasks and making decisions autonomously in research contexts.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for research and analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discusses various AI-powered tools and platforms used for conducting research, including data collection, analysis, and insight generation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated personas or simulated users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, recruitment, and the overall structure of the workforce, including AI's role in hiring and skill development.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Highlights AI tools designed to help developers write, debug, and review code more efficiently.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Covers the comparison, benchmarking, and assessment of different AI tools and platforms for various applications.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications specifically within the fields of design and user research, including AI's role in creative processes and insight gathering.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Details how AI is used to analyze customer data and provide actionable insights for businesses.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, impact, and effectiveness of AI chatbots in various contexts, including their potential harms and benefits.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
